concept.title: Hitachi Content Platform object storage
concept.shortdesc: You can configure Red Hat Quay to use Hitachi Content Platform (HCP) as an object storage backend. Use this example to set credentials, bucket details, and connection options.

conbody.codeblock: DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_CONFIG: hcp_us: - RadosGWStorage - access_key: <access_key> bucket_name: <bucket_name> hostname: <hitachi_hostname_example> is_secure: true secret_key: <secret_key> storage_path: /datastorage/registry signature_version: v4 DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_DEFAULT_LOCATIONS: - hcp_us DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_PREFERENCE: - hcp_us
